<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Timur Satria Wianto — Portofolio Lean Manufacturing</title>

<!--
========================================================================
  PANDUAN EDIT CEPAT (baca ini dulu sebelum mengubah apapun)
========================================================================
  1. TEKS: semua teks profil, pengalaman, dan angka ditandai komentar
     EDIT di dalam HTML di bawah. Cari kata "EDIT" dengan Ctrl+F pada
     text editor untuk lompat ke bagian yang mau diubah.

  2. FOTO: semua foto dan sertifikat sudah tertanam otomatis (format
     base64) supaya file ini tetap satu file saja dan bisa langsung
     dibuka di browser mana pun tanpa folder tambahan.

  3. WARNA & FONT: semua diatur di satu tempat lewat CSS variable
     root di bawah, supaya gampang ganti palet warna sekali jalan
     tanpa perlu scroll ke seluruh file.
========================================================================
-->

<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#122241;
    --navy-deep:#0B1729;
    --navy-mid:#1D3760;
    --paper:#F4F5F1;
    --paper-dim:#E7E9E1;
    --line:#C9CDC1;
    --amber:#EE9F1C;
    --green:#3E8E5C;
    --steel:#5B6572;
    --ink:#161A22;
    --ink-soft:#4A5160;
    --white:#FFFFFF;
    --radius:2px;
    --font-display:'Space Grotesk', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;
    --font-body:'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
    --font-mono:'IBM Plex Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
  }

  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}

  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}

  body{
    font-family:var(--font-body);
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--ink);
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }

  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}

  a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}

  /* ---------- Blueprint grid background ---------- */
  .blueprint-bg{
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.045) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.045) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size:32px 32px;
  }
  .blueprint-bg-light{
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(rgba(18,34,65,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(18,34,65,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size:28px 28px;
  }

  .eyebrow{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:.14em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--amber);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .eyebrow::before{
    content:'';
    width:26px; height:2px; background:var(--amber);
    display:inline-block;
  }
  .eyebrow.dark{color:var(--navy-mid);}
  .eyebrow.dark::before{background:var(--navy-mid);}

  .wrap{max-width:1140px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 32px;}

  h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.01em;}

  .section-title{
    font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,40px);
    color:var(--navy);
    max-width:640px;
    margin-bottom:12px;
  }
  .section-sub{
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    max-width:560px;
    font-size:16px;
    margin-bottom:48px;
  }

  section{padding:96px 0;}

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  .nav{
    position:fixed; top:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:100;
    background:rgba(11,23,41,0.92);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }
  .nav-inner{
    max-width:1140px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 32px;
    height:64px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  }
  .nav-logo{
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:13px; color:var(--white);
    letter-spacing:.06em;
  }
  .nav-logo span{color:var(--amber);}
  .nav-links{display:flex; gap:28px; list-style:none;}
  .nav-links a{
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12.5px; color:#B9C2D4;
    text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em;
    transition:color .2s;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--amber);}
  .nav-cta{
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12px;
    color:var(--navy-deep); background:var(--amber);
    padding:8px 16px; border-radius:var(--radius);
    text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em;
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .nav-toggle{display:none;}

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    background:var(--navy-deep);
    color:var(--white);
    padding:150px 0 90px;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero::after{
    content:'';
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    background:radial-gradient(ellipse 700px 400px at 85% 10%, rgba(238,159,28,0.12), transparent 70%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hero-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;
    gap:56px;
    align-items:center;
    position:relative;
    z-index:1;
  }
  .hero-kicker{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:12.5px;
    color:var(--amber);
    letter-spacing:.16em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    margin-bottom:22px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  }
  .hero-kicker .dot{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--amber); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(238,159,28,0.18);}
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(38px,5.4vw,60px);
    line-height:1.05;
    margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  .hero h1 .accent{color:var(--amber);}
  .hero-role{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:15px;
    color:#A9B4C9;
    margin-bottom:26px;
    letter-spacing:.02em;
  }
  .hero-desc{
    font-size:16.5px;
    color:#C7CEDC;
    max-width:520px;
    margin-bottom:36px;
  }
  .hero-actions{display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:44px;}
  .btn{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:.03em;
    padding:13px 22px;
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px;
    transition:transform .18s ease, background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
    cursor:pointer;
    border:1px solid transparent;
  }
  .btn-primary{background:var(--amber); color:var(--navy-deep); font-weight:600;}
  .btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); background:#F7B23B;}
  .btn-ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.28); color:var(--white);}
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--amber); color:var(--amber); transform:translateY(-2px);}

  .hero-stats{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
    border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
    padding-top:26px;
    max-width:520px;
  }
  .hero-stat b{
    font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:24px; color:var(--white); display:block;
  }
  .hero-stat span{
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:#8C97AC; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em;
  }

  .hero-photo-wrap{
    position:relative;
    justify-self:end;
  }
  .id-card{
    width:280px;
    background:var(--navy-mid);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    padding:18px 18px 22px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .id-card::before{
    content:'';
    position:absolute; top:-1px; left:-1px; right:-1px; bottom:-1px;
    border:1px dashed rgba(238,159,28,0.35);
    pointer-events:none;
    margin:6px;
  }
  .id-card-photo{
    width:100%; aspect-ratio:3/4; overflow:hidden;
    background:#0B1729;
    margin-bottom:14px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  }
  .id-card-photo img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover;}
  .id-card-label{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10.5px; color:var(--amber); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:4px;}
  .id-card-name{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:17px; color:var(--white); margin-bottom:2px;}
  .id-card-sub{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:#9AA5B9;}
  .id-card-foot{
    margin-top:14px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; color:#7C8698;
  }

  /* ---------- Value stream (signature element) ---------- */
  .vsm{
    background:var(--navy-deep);
    padding:70px 0 100px;
    color:var(--white);
  }
  .vsm-track{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);
    gap:0;
    position:relative;
    margin-top:52px;
  }
  .vsm-track::before{
    content:'';
    position:absolute; top:38px; left:0; right:0; height:1px;
    background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(238,159,28,0.5) 0 8px, transparent 8px 16px);
  }
  .vsm-node{position:relative; padding:0 14px;}
  .vsm-node:first-child{padding-left:0;}
  .vsm-node:last-child{padding-right:0;}
  .vsm-marker{
    width:12px; height:12px; background:var(--amber);
    border-radius:50%;
    margin-bottom:26px;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(238,159,28,0.16);
  }
  .vsm-year{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--amber); letter-spacing:.05em; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .vsm-box{
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    padding:16px 14px;
    min-height:150px;
  }
  .vsm-box h4{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--white); margin-bottom:8px; line-height:1.3;}
  .vsm-box p{font-size:12.5px; color:#9AA5B9; font-family:var(--font-mono); line-height:1.55;}
  .vsm-box.target{
    background:rgba(238,159,28,0.08);
    border-color:rgba(238,159,28,0.45);
  }
  .vsm-box.target h4{color:var(--amber);}

  /* ---------- About ---------- */
  .about{background:var(--paper);}
  .about-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:64px;}
  .about-text p{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:16px; margin-bottom:18px;}
  .about-text p strong{color:var(--navy); font-weight:600;}
  .about-list{list-style:none; margin-top:26px;}
  .about-list li{
    display:flex; gap:12px; padding:12px 0;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .about-list li b{color:var(--navy); min-width:150px; font-weight:600;}

  .spec-card{
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    background:var(--white);
    padding:26px;
  }
  .spec-card-title{
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.1em;
    text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--steel); margin-bottom:18px;
    padding-bottom:12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .spec-row{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:11px 0; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line); font-size:13.5px;}
  .spec-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .spec-row span:first-child{color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .spec-row span:last-child{font-family:var(--font-mono); color:var(--navy); font-weight:600; text-align:right;}

  /* ---------- Experience ---------- */
  .exp{background:var(--paper-dim);}
  .exp-item{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:48px;
    background:var(--white);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    margin-bottom:28px;
  }
  .exp-item:nth-child(even) .exp-media{order:2;}
  .exp-body{padding:38px 40px;}
  .exp-tag{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--amber); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.08em; margin-bottom:10px;}
  .exp-title{font-size:21px; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:4px;}
  .exp-period{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12.5px; color:var(--steel); margin-bottom:20px;}
  .exp-desc{font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-style:italic; margin-bottom:16px;}
  .exp-body ul{list-style:none;}
  .exp-body li{
    position:relative; padding-left:20px; margin-bottom:12px;
    font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.6;
  }
  .exp-body li::before{
    content:'▸'; position:absolute; left:0; color:var(--amber); font-size:13px;
  }
  .metric-chip{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:6px;
    background:var(--paper); border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:8px 14px; margin-top:14px; margin-right:10px;
  }
  .metric-chip b{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:20px; color:var(--green);}
  .metric-chip span{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10.5px; color:var(--steel); text-transform:uppercase;}

  .exp-media{padding:32px; display:flex; align-items:center; background:var(--paper);}
  .photo-stack{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; width:100%;}

  /* ---------- Photo placeholder ---------- */
  .photo-slot{
    width:100%; aspect-ratio:4/3;
    border:1.5px dashed #A9AF9F;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(18,34,65,0.03) 25%, transparent 25%) 0 0/16px 16px,
      linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 75%, rgba(18,34,65,0.03) 75%) 0 0/16px 16px,
      var(--paper);
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    text-align:center; gap:8px; padding:20px;
    color:var(--steel);
    transition:border-color .2s;
  }
  .photo-slot:hover{border-color:var(--amber);}
  .photo-slot svg{width:30px; height:30px; opacity:.55;}
  .photo-slot b{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--navy);}
  .photo-slot span{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10.5px; color:var(--steel); max-width:180px;}
  .photo-slot.square{aspect-ratio:1/1;}
  .photo-slot.portrait{aspect-ratio:3/4;}

  /* ---------- Filled photo (real documentation) ---------- */
  .photo-real{border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--white); overflow:hidden; width:100%;}
  .photo-real img{width:100%; aspect-ratio:4/3; object-fit:cover; display:block;}
  .photo-real.portrait img{aspect-ratio:3/4;}
  .photo-real .photo-caption{
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; line-height:1.55;
    padding:12px 14px; color:var(--ink-soft); border-top:1px dashed var(--line); background:var(--paper);
  }
  .gallery .photo-real{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.18); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02);}
  .gallery .photo-real .photo-caption{color:#9AA5B9; border-top-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.14); background:transparent;}

  /* ---------- Motivation strip ---------- */
  .motivation{
    margin-top:64px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:220px 1fr; gap:36px;
    background:var(--paper-dim); border:1px solid var(--line); padding:30px;
    align-items:center;
  }
  .motivation img{width:100%; border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .motivation h4{font-size:16px; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:10px;}
  .motivation p{font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-soft);}

  /* ---------- Edu photo ---------- */
  .edu-block{display:grid; grid-template-columns:220px 1fr; gap:36px; align-items:start;}
  .edu-photo{border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .edu-photo img{width:100%; aspect-ratio:3/4; object-fit:cover; display:block;}
  .edu-photo .photo-caption{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10.5px; padding:10px 12px; color:var(--steel); border-top:1px dashed var(--line); background:var(--white);}

  /* ---------- Cert with real thumbnail ---------- */
  .cert-card.filled{padding:0; overflow:hidden;}
  .cert-card.filled img{width:100%; aspect-ratio:4/3; object-fit:cover; display:block; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .cert-card.filled .cert-text{padding:20px 22px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;}

  /* ---------- Crop position helpers ---------- */
  .photo-real img.pos-top{object-position:center top;}
  .photo-real img.pos-bottom{object-position:center bottom;}
  .photo-real.tall img{aspect-ratio:3/4;}

  /* ---------- Project (Tugas Akhir) ---------- */
  .project{background:var(--navy-deep); color:var(--white);}
  .project .section-title{color:var(--white);}
  .project .section-sub{color:#9AA5B9;}
  .project-top{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.3fr .7fr; gap:56px; margin-bottom:56px;}
  .project-desc p{color:#C3CBDB; margin-bottom:16px; font-size:15.5px;}
  .method-tags{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:9px; margin-top:22px;}
  .method-tag{
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11.5px; padding:7px 13px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color:#C3CBDB;
  }
  .case-box{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); padding:24px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);}
  .case-box .eyebrow{margin-bottom:12px;}
  .case-box p{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:13px; color:#9AA5B9; line-height:1.7;}

  .before-after{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; gap:0;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16);
  }
  .ba-col{padding:32px 28px;}
  .ba-col.current{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02);}
  .ba-col.future{background:rgba(62,142,92,0.09);}
  .ba-label{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:16px;}
  .ba-col.current .ba-label{color:#9AA5B9;}
  .ba-col.future .ba-label{color:var(--green);}
  .ba-num{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:34px; margin-bottom:4px;}
  .ba-col.future .ba-num{color:var(--green);}
  .ba-unit{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11.5px; color:#8C97AC; margin-bottom:18px;}
  .ba-sub{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12px; color:#8C97AC;}
  .ba-arrow{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    border-left:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-right:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    padding:0 22px;
  }
  .ba-arrow-inner{text-align:center;}
  .ba-arrow-inner b{display:block; font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:22px; color:var(--amber);}
  .ba-arrow-inner span{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; color:#8C97AC; text-transform:uppercase;}

  .impact-row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:1px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.14); margin-top:1px;}
  .impact-cell{background:var(--navy-deep); padding:26px 24px;}
  .impact-cell b{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:30px; color:var(--amber); display:block; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .impact-cell span{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11.5px; color:#9AA5B9;}

  /* ---------- Skills ---------- */
  .skills{background:var(--paper);}
  .skill-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:1px; background:var(--line); border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .skill-col{background:var(--white); padding:28px 24px;}
  .skill-col h4{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--amber); margin-bottom:16px; padding-bottom:12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .skill-col ul{list-style:none;}
  .skill-col li{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); padding:6px 0;}

  /* ---------- Certifications ---------- */
  .certs{background:var(--paper-dim);}
  .cert-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:22px;}
  .cert-card{
    background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--line); padding:26px;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px;
  }
  .cert-icon{width:36px; height:36px; color:var(--amber);}
  .cert-card h4{font-size:15.5px; color:var(--navy); line-height:1.35;}
  .cert-card span{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11.5px; color:var(--steel);}
  .cert-card.empty{
    border:1.5px dashed #A9AF9F; background:transparent;
    align-items:center; text-align:center; justify-content:center; min-height:210px;
  }
  .cert-card.empty b{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11.5px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--navy);}
  .cert-card.empty span{max-width:200px;}
  .cert-card.pending{
    border:1.5px solid var(--amber); background:rgba(238,159,28,0.05);
    align-items:flex-start; justify-content:center; min-height:210px; gap:12px;
  }
  .cert-card.pending .status-badge{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em;
    color:var(--amber); border:1px solid var(--amber); padding:5px 10px;
  }
  .cert-card.pending .status-badge::before{content:''; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--amber);}
  .cert-card.pending h4{font-size:15.5px; color:var(--navy); line-height:1.35;}
  .cert-card.pending p{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.6;}

  /* ---------- Organization ---------- */
  .org{background:var(--paper);}
  .org-item{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:.7fr 1.3fr .55fr; gap:28px;
    padding:30px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    align-items:start;
  }
  .org-item:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .org-thumb{border:1px solid var(--line); overflow:hidden;}
  .org-thumb img{width:100%; aspect-ratio:4/3; object-fit:cover; display:block;}
  .org-thumb .photo-caption{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; padding:8px 10px; color:var(--steel); border-top:1px dashed var(--line); background:var(--paper);}
  .org-period{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--steel);}
  .org-role{font-size:17px; color:var(--navy); margin:4px 0 2px;}
  .org-name{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12.5px; color:var(--steel); margin-bottom10px;}
  .org-desc{font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:8px;}

  /* ---------- Documentation gallery ---------- */
  .gallery{background:var(--navy-deep); color:var(--white);}
  .gallery .section-title{color:var(--white);}
  .gallery .section-sub{color:#9AA5B9;}
  .gallery-group{margin-bottom:44px;}
  .gallery-group h4{
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12.5px; color:var(--amber);
    text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; margin-bottom:16px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  }
  .gallery-group h4::after{content:''; flex:1; height:1px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.14);}
  .gallery-row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:16px;}
  .gallery .photo-slot{
    border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.25); color:#9AA5B9;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 25%, transparent 25%) 0 0/16px 16px,
      linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 75%, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 75%) 0 0/16px 16px,
      transparent;
  }
  .gallery .photo-slot b{color:var(--white);}
  .gallery .photo-slot:hover{border-color:var(--amber);}

  /* ---------- Education ---------- */
  .edu{background:var(--paper);}
  .edu-card{
    border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--white);
    padding:36px 40px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:30px; align-items:start;
  }
  .edu-card h3{font-size:22px; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:6px;}
  .edu-card .org-sub{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:13px; color:var(--steel); margin-bottom:16px;}
  .edu-courses{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.8; margin-top:12px;}
  .edu-side{text-align:right;}
  .edu-side .gpa{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:32px; color:var(--green);}
  .edu-side .gpa-label{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10.5px; color:var(--steel); text-transform:uppercase;}
  .edu-status{
    margin-top:16px; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--amber);
    border:1px solid var(--amber); padding:6px 10px; display:inline-block;
  }

  /* ---------- Footer / Contact ---------- */
  .contact{background:var(--navy-deep); color:var(--white); padding:100px 0 40px;}
  .contact-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr; gap:60px; padding-bottom:60px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);}
  .contact h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.5vw,46px); margin-bottom:18px;}
  .contact h2 .accent{color:var(--amber);}
  .contact p{color:#9AA5B9; max-width:440px; margin-bottom:32px;}
  .contact-links{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px;}
  .contact-link{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
    padding:16px 0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:13.5px;
  }
  .contact-link:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);}
  .contact-link span:first-child{color:#8C97AC; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.06em;}
  .contact-link span:last-child{color:var(--white);}
  .contact-link:hover span:last-child{color:var(--amber);}
  .foot-bottom{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
    padding-top:28px; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11.5px; color:#6E798D;
  }

  /* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width:860px){
    .nav-inner{gap:14px;}
    .nav-links{
      display:flex; gap:16px; overflow-x:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
      scrollbar-width:none; flex:1; margin:0 8px;
    }
    .nav-links::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
    .nav-links li{flex:0 0 auto;}
    .nav-links a{white-space:nowrap;}
    .nav-cta{white-space:nowrap; padding:8px 12px; font-size:11px;}
    .nav-logo{font-size:11px; flex:0 0 auto;}
    .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .hero-photo-wrap{justify-self:start; margin-top:40px;}
    .about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:40px;}
    .exp-item{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .exp-item:nth-child(even) .exp-media{order:0;}
    .vsm-track{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:34px;}
    .vsm-track::before{display:none;}
    .project-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .before-after{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .ba-arrow{border-left:none; border-right:none; border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.18); padding:16px 0;}
    .impact-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .skill-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
    .cert-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .org-item{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:14px;}
    .gallery-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
    .edu-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .edu-side{text-align:left;}
    .edu-block{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .motivation{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .wrap{padding:0 20px;}
  }
</style>
</head>

        <p>Terbiasa mengolah data proses produksi, menyusun usulan perbaikan berbasis data, serta mengomunikasikan hasil analisis kepada level manajemen. Memiliki pengalaman kontribusi nyata pada proyek continuous improvement yang berhasil meningkatkan kecepatan mesin produksi secara terukur.</p>
        <p>Tertarik mendalami <strong>Toyota Production System</strong> secara langsung — filosofi yang menjadi rujukan utama dalam seluruh metode yang dipelajari selama masa studi dan magang.</p>
        <ul class="about-list">

<!-- ================= PROYEK / TUGAS AKHIR ================= -->
<section class="project" id="proyek">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="eyebrow">Proyek Akademik</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Tugas Akhir — Implementasi Lean Manufacturing</h2>
    <div class="project-top">
      <div class="project-desc">
        <p><strong>Studi kasus:</strong> PT Universal Fishing Gear Solutions, lini produksi Rod FNX 662.</p>
        <p>Mengidentifikasi tiga waste dominan — <em>waiting</em> (20%), <em>defect</em> (18%), dan <em>inventory</em> (15%) — dari tujuh jenis waste melalui kuesioner Likert kepada 10 responden, dianalisis dengan Value Stream Mapping dan Value Stream Analysis Tools.</p>
        <p>Usulan perbaikan berbasis Kaizen mencakup SOP WIP Limit berbasis FIFO Family, Visual Work Instruction terstandar, sistem conveyor antarstasiun, dan desain Automatic Drying Machine yang dimodelkan 3D menggunakan SolidWorks. Naskah penelitian disusun ulang menjadi manuskrip publikasi ilmiah dengan format jurnal terindeks Scopus.</p>
        <div class="method-tags">
          <span class="method-tag">VSM</span>
          <span class="method-tag">VALSAT</span>
          <span class="method-tag">Process Activity Mapping</span>
          <span class="method-tag">Fishbone Diagram</span>
          <span class="method-tag">5W1H</span>
          <span class="method-tag">Kaizen</span>
          <span class="method-tag">SolidWorks 3D</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="case-box">
        <div class="eyebrow">Waste Dominan</div>
        <p>WAITING — 20%<br>DEFECT — 18%<br>INVENTORY — 15%<br><br>Diukur dari 7 jenis waste melalui kuesioner Likert terhadap 10 responden di lini produksi.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="before-after">
      <div class="ba-col current">
        <div class="ba-label">Current State</div>
        <div class="ba-num">101</div>
        <div class="ba-unit">aktivitas produksi</div>
        <div class="ba-sub">95.904 detik / batch</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ba-arrow">
        <div class="ba-arrow-inner"><b>−46.682</b><span>detik per batch</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="ba-col future">
        <div class="ba-label">Future State</div>
        <div class="ba-num">95</div>
        <div class="ba-unit">aktivitas produksi</div>
        <div class="ba-sub">49.222 detik / batch</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="impact-row">
      <div class="impact-cell"><b>48.67%</b><span>Reduksi total waktu proses</span></div>
      <div class="impact-cell"><b>72.6%</b><span>Reduksi lead time produksi</span></div>
      <div class="impact-cell"><b>↑ VA</b><span>Peningkatan proporsi aktivitas bernilai tambah</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

        <ul>
          <li>Merancang produk baru secara end-to-end: identifikasi peluang, Voice of Customer, penyusunan spesifikasi, hingga pemilihan konsep terbaik.</li>
          <li>Mendesain "PortaDesk" — meja kerja portabel beroda dengan laci dan permukaan meja yang dapat diatur sudutnya — dalam SolidWorks lengkap dengan Bill of Material.</li>
          <li>Menyusun studi kelayakan usaha produk (HPP, Capital &amp; Operational Expenditure, NPV, IRR) sebagai bagian dari modul kewirausahaan.</li>
          <li>Merealisasikan desain menjadi prototipe fisik fungsional berbahan kayu.</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="metric-chip"><b>3 Modul</b><span>Produk · Usaha · Organisasi</span></div>
      </div>

          <div class="photo-caption">Exploded view &amp; Bill of Material — desain "PortaDesk" (SolidWorks)</div>
        </div>
        </div>

    <!-- PRAKTIKUM 3: PPST II - Layout PT Nawasena -->
    <div class="exp-item">
      <div class="exp-media">
        <div class="photo-real">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Desain layout fasilitas PT Nawasena menggunakan Microsoft Visio">

        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="exp-body">
        <div class="exp-tag">Proyek Perancangan Sistem Terintegrasi II</div>
        <h3 class="exp-title">Tata Letak Fasilitas — PT Nawasena</h3>
        <p class="exp-desc">Kelanjutan proyek PortaDesk: merancang pabrik untuk produksi skala massal</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Merancang tata letak fasilitas manufaktur untuk memproduksi PortaDesk secara massal di bawah entitas perusahaan "PT Nawasena", mencakup penempatan stasiun kerja (scroll saw, crosscut, drilling, assembly, finishing) dan fasilitas pendukung menggunakan Microsoft Visio.</li>
          <li>Merancang sistem logistik dan rantai pasok, termasuk Distribution Requirement Planning (DRP) dan optimasi rute distribusi (Nearest Neighbour, Nearest Insert, Constraint Programming).</li>
          <li>Mengintegrasikan proses manufaktur ke sistem ERP Odoo, meliputi BOM, work center, routing, hingga alur sales order-to-cash.</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="metric-chip"><b>3 Modul</b><span>Layout · Rantai Pasok · ERP</span></div>
